narrative: Smallest possible scenario: log in via dev-login.
No project gets created, no agents run.
Used by the schema integrity tests to keep the validator alive in CI.
key_invariants: Exactly two user actions land in the timeline
First action navigates to '/' (the home page)
Second action targets the dev-login button

actions.intent: Open the home page to begin a recording session
Log in via the dev-login shortcut so a recording session starts authenticated
actions.rationale: 录制场景需要先登录,使用 dev-login 直登避免邮件验证流程
